inputs.text: People, this Cyprus power grab is a stark illustration of how the elite are using structural reforms to shield themselves while laying bare the most vulnerable to unchecked power. By stripping judicial oversight from surveillance laws, they're leaving communities already crushed by systemic discrimination, activists, and workers defenseless against state spying that will surely focus on those enduring historical inequality. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides flagged this after a closed House session, and the amended bill is heading straight for a vote in the plenum on Thursday. These changes have nothing to do with security—they're about deepening inequality, silencing labor voices and dissent from oppressed groups, and upholding institutional abuse. We need to organize and push back hard for real protections and accountability before this normalizes the targeting of the disadvantaged.
